pages.name: Slav Defense: Czech Variation, Krause Attack
pages.notes: Overview promised a swift kingside attack; plan 1 gave f4, a g4-h4 storm and an f7 sacrifice instead of Nxc4 or f3/e4; plan 3 had Black target its own c4-pawn; plan 4 named ...e5 with the knight on e5. Rewrote all.

pages.name: Slav: Central, 6.Ne5 Na6
pages.notes: Overview called 6...Na6 the Chebanenko and said Nb4 attacks d4; plan 2 did the same and named ...e5 with the knight on e5; plan 3 played Nxf6, a move no piece can make. Rewrote all; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Central, 6.Ne5 Na6 7.f3
pages.notes: Plan 2 named ...e5 with the knight on e5; plan 3 developed the bishop via g3 to b2. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Central, 6.Ne5 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's Nxc4 and ...e5 in a Black plan before they happen. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Central, 7.f3 Bb4 8.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 3 gave e3, Bd3 and 0-0 after f3; plan 4 named White's Bh4 in a Black plan and ...g5 onto the bishop's square. Rewrote plans 3-4 around the Bg5 pin backing e4; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Central, Carlsbad, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked e6 with Ng5, a square no knight can reach, and called the d7-knight pinned; plan 2 rerouted a knight from f6, where a pawn stands. Rewrote both; spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Central, Main Line
pages.notes: Overview called the line the Poisoned Pawn and miscounted the material (first rewrite rejected: White has an extra piece for four pawns, as Black keeps the b8-knight; fixed and re-accepted); plan 1 used an e4-pawn that is gone and a Kc2-Kb1 route; plan 3 called the 13...Qd5 middlegame a queen endgame. Rewrote all three.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...Nbd7 9.Nh4
pages.notes: Plan 1 repeated 9.Nh4 as a plan; plan 2 gave an ...a5-b5 route; plan 4 named White's Nxf5 in a Black plan. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...Nbd7 9.Qb3 a5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Qe2 from b3 and routed a knight Ne2-c1-a2-b4 (first rewrite rejected for claiming pressure on b7 through the b4-bishop; fixed and re-accepted); plan 2 called the b4-bishop's hold on c3 a pin with the king castled. British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...Nbd7 9.Qe2 Bg6
pages.notes: Plan 3 named White's e4 in a Black plan. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere.
